I am an old woman farming a very small maize plot, so I must be careful with money and use only a little purchased input. Here in Mbeya, maize can do better with some fertilizer and improved seed, but on my small land I would keep the amount low and depend mostly on family work, with maybe a little help hired for heavy work. I would not irrigate, and I would not usually buy pesticide for maize.
